Proposal faster-reply-sample · revision 1Part 3 of 3

The reward is used inside the task

Apply the grant to the next sent chat message and consume it when that character reply is delivered.

→

Product case

A single sample may clarify a paid benefit, but it could divert subscriptions or add priority-serving costs.

What to validate

Leaving Model settings can return the user to chat; that exit was not observed. A one-reply faster grant, account-level one-use limit, and capacity check can be implemented reliably.
